title: Decomposition after removing trailing ones
statement: For every Boolean word $w$, there is a natural number $r$ such that $w$ is the concatenation of the word obtained by removing all trailing $1$s from $w$ and a string of $r$ copies of $1$. The resulting prefix is either empty or ends in $0$.
